# Radio Buttons

Radio Buttons allow users to choose a single item from a list of options.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `radio_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.radio_field }}

{% for value, label in entry.radio_field.options %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}

{% for value, label in entry.radio_field.selected %}
    {{ label }} - {{ value }}
{% endfor %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->radio_field }}

@foreach($entry->radio_field->options as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach

@foreach($entry->radio_field->selected as $value => $label)
    {{ $label }} - {{ $value }}
@endforeach
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>


:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [Radio Buttons fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/radio-buttons.html)
:::
